mapper.select: SELECT time_id AS timeId, category, title, time, note, location, order_no AS orderNo FROM hrm_worship_time WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY order_no ASC, sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hrm_worship_time (category, title, time, note, location, order_no, use_yn) VALUES (#{category}, #{title}, #{time}, #{note}, #{location}, #{orderNo}, 'Y')
